description.value: Glacier Mountaineer Lodge is listed as a hotel on Kicking Horse Trail within the Kicking Horse Mountain Resort area of Golden, British Columbia. Golden sits at the gateway to Yoho, Glacier, and Banff National Parks, offering year-round access to alpine terrain and road cycling in the Canadian Rockies. The associated Kicking Horse Lodging portfolio includes several on-mountain and in-town properties managed by Bellstar Resorts.
